google.title: Google Meet
google.intro: Connect a Google account to create Google Meet video calls from record conversations. The link is posted in the conversation and participants are notified.
google.disconnect_confirm: Video calls cannot be created until an account is connected again. Continue?
google.setup_1: In Google Cloud Console, create a project and enable the "Google Meet REST API".
google.setup_2: Configure the OAuth consent screen (internal type for a Google Workspace account) with the meetings.space.created scope.

google.setup_4: Put client_id and client_secret in 'google' in config.local.php and press "Connect with Google".
